title: 1,700-Year-Old Water Town Near Shanghai — Bridge or Boat? | China Travel Expert
description:
About an hour from downtown Shanghai, Zhujiajiao is a canal town with more than 1,700 years of history — one of the best-preserved water towns in the region, often called the "Venice of Shanghai."

Instead of roads, it has water: 36 ancient bridges arch across the canals, the grandest being the five-arch Fangsheng Bridge, and wooden rowboats slide underneath them carrying visitors between the old lanes. So the real question is how you want to see it — on foot over the stone bridges, or low on the water looking up.

🧭 Expert Tip: go on a weekday. Zhujiajiao is a favorite Shanghai day trip and the narrow lanes and bridges get packed on weekends.

离上海一小时，朱家角——1700 多年的水乡，36 座古桥，一条乌篷船。你选走桥，还是坐船？
